in_urdu.name: Hiddah
in_urdu.meaning: اسلامی نام جس کا مطلب ہے Secret, Hidden
in_urdu.long_meaning: Hiddah ایک اسلامی نام ہے جو مسلم ثقافت میں گہری روحانی اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔ Derived from the Arabic root 'hdh', meaning 'to hide'. In Islamic tradition, Hiddah symbolizes the hidden knowledge and wisdom granted to the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) through divine revelation.

in_hindi.name: Hiddah
in_hindi.meaning: इस्लामी नाम जिसका अर्थ है Secret, Hidden
in_hindi.long_meaning: Hiddah एक इस्लामी नाम है जो मुस्लिम संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Arabic root 'hdh', meaning 'to hide'. In Islamic tradition, Hiddah symbolizes the hidden knowledge and wisdom granted to the Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) through divine revelation.

in_pashto.meaning: اسلامي نوم چې معنی یې ده Secret, Hidden
